quote: However, a flow() builder function must emit values from the same coroutine context where it runs.
note: 官方頁面的 withContext 範例標註 This fails with an exception!,並指向 flowOn;Android 頁也寫不可在不同 CoroutineContext emit。

quote: Only once collection begins against the returned Flow, should work actually be done.
note: detekt SuspendFunWithFlowReturnType 說明回傳 Flow 的函式不應標 suspend,理由是 Flow 為冷流、呼叫本身不應有副作用;與型錄一致。
查了 kotlinlang catch.html、coroutines-flow 頁、detekt 搜尋(EmptyCatchBlock/SwallowedException):官方頁只說明 catch 處理上游例外並可 emit 備援值,沒有任何一頁明講『空本體 .catch{} 吞錯』是壞寫法;detekt 規則針對 try/catch,非 Flow.catch。僅有部落格層級說法,不採用。

quote: Since the collect() lambda runs after .catch(), you can't use .catch() to handle exceptions thrown from it.
note: 官方同頁建議把每值邏輯放 .onEach() 之後接 .catch(),與型錄標準寫法一致。

quote: This operator is transparent to exceptions that occur in downstream flow and does not catch exceptions that are thrown to cancel the flow.
note: catch API 範例註解明寫只抓 catch 之前 (emitData、computeOne) 的例外,catch 之後的 map 與 collect 例外照常往外拋。

quote: When you catch an exception thrown by the collector inside a flow builder function, rethrow it.
note: 官方說在 flow 建構內 try 包 emit 會吃到下游例外,需重拋以維持例外透明;上游例外改用 .catch() 處理,與型錄一致。

quote: You can't start another coroutine that calls emit() in its block, and you can't change the coroutine context with withContext().
note: 官方並建議改用 channelFlow() 讓多個協程 emit;Android 頁則指向 callbackFlow。

quote: Note that simply applying an intermediate operator to a stream does not start the flow collection.
note: Android 官方頁明講中間運算子只是設定操作鏈、不會啟動收集,與型錄後果一致。
Android 範例把存快取的副作用放 .onEach、map 只做轉換,Kotlin 頁說明 onEach 在每值往下游前執行,但兩頁都沒有明講『map 內做副作用是壞寫法/融合或重複收集時副作用會重複或不執行』;detekt 規則清單也查不到 SideEffectInMapOperator。標準寫法有範例旁證,壞寫法的錯因沒有權威原文。

quote: This means that the producer code is executed each time a terminal operator is called on the flow.
note: Android 頁接著說多個 collector 會讓資料來源重複抓取,並建議用 shareIn 共享;Kotlin 頁也寫 Each collector triggers a new, independent execution。

quote: A call to Flow.collect on a state flow never completes normally, and neither does a coroutine started by the Flow.launchIn function.
note: SharedFlow 頁有同款句子;第二個 collect 永不執行是由此推得。

quote: Since StateFlow is a hot flow, collection doesn’t complete on its own.
note: Kotlin 頁以 takeWhile 截斷;StateFlow 頁寫 collect 永不正常完成,與型錄一致(toList 未明文提及,屬推論)。

quote: Application of flowOn, conflate, buffer with CONFLATED or RENDEZVOUS capacity, distinctUntilChanged, or cancellable operators to a state flow has no effect.
note: 與型錄相符;SharedFlow 頁另寫 flowOn、buffer(RENDEZVOUS)、cancellable 無效。官方文件確認無效,未涉棄用宣告(型錄『待查』部分仍未核對)。

quote: The crucial difference from collect is that when the original flow emits a new value then the action block for the previous value is cancelled.
note: 官方確認前一值的處理區塊會被取消;『寫入做一半』屬推論,NonCancellable 作法未在此頁明文。

quote: emit call to such a shared flow suspends until all subscribers receive the emitted value and returns immediately if there are no subscribers.
note: 同段寫明無訂閱者時值立刻遺失(the emitted value is immediately lost);onSubscription 在訂閱註冊後才執行動作,與型錄一致。

quote: Unlike consumeEach, this for loop pattern is perfectly safe to use from multiple coroutines.
note: channels 頁同段說 consumeEach 結束時會取消底層 channel;consumeEach API 頁寫 cancels the channel afterward,並說明適用於單一消費者。

quote: whereas trySend does not add the element to the channel and returns false immediately.
note: 同頁寫明 callbackFlow 的 channel 預設容量 64;滿了 trySend 回傳 false。『靜默遺失』是忽略回傳值的結果,DROP_OLDEST 作法未在此頁明文。

quote: awaitClose should be used to keep the flow running, otherwise the channel will be closed immediately when block completes.
note: callbackFlow 頁並寫 Using awaitClose is mandatory in order to prevent memory leaks;channelFlow 頁寫明用於不同 context 或並行生產元素,與型錄分工一致。
